name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for my bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for my bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize experience with custom bathroom remodels, strong communication skills, and a transparent contracting process. Look for contractors with a solid portfolio of relevant projects, positive client references, and proper licensing and insurance. Ensure they offer a clear, itemized proposal and a realistic project timeline. A good contractor will guide you through material selection, design choices, and permitting requirements efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in custom remodels, strong communication, transparent pricing, proper licensing, and positive references to ensure a successful project.
